name: Session-handoff ORB — US-open break of the overnight range (15m, session-anchored)
rationale: MECHANISM: crypto is 24/7 but directional flow is regional. Overnight (Asia/EU) inventory gets re-priced when the deep US liquidity window opens; desks that must mark/hedge at the US session start chase the break of the overnight range while overnight range-traders and market-makers fade until the flow overwhelms them. Zarattini/Barbon and Concretum (2018-2025) find ETH Europe->US cross-session momentum nets Sharpe ~0.8 after fees precisely because the per-trade edge clears >3x the taker hurdle. This is a structural flow handoff (not a crowded stat-arb signal), so it persists. Entry: a session-anchored opening-range breakout (setup.orb anchor='session') gated by adx (only trade the break when a directional regime is present) and a positive trailing return (ret_Nd) confirming the handoff pushes with, not against, established flow. DISCONFIRMER: kill if the SAME orb with anchor='rolling' (no session anchor) nets identically — that proves the timing is curve-fit and the session carries nothing. Also kill if it does not clear DSR 0.95 net of our fee schedule and beat buy-and-hold.
catalyst: US session open breaking the Asia/EU overnight range
